blocks.text: DUBLIN — Irish boxer Lee Reeves has died more than three months after being injured during a fight in Dublin, promoter Queensberry said Tuesday. He was 31. “Everyone at Queensberry is devastated to learn of the passing of Lee Reeves,” Queensberry Promotions said in a statement. Reeves was hospitalized after being knocked out by compatriot Gary Cully in the 10th and final round of their Boxing Union of Ireland Celtic super-lightweight title fight on Aug. 1.
